segments.name: Correspondent clearing
products: Trading in equity securities for its own account
segments.description: AtlasClearing is a correspondent securities broker-dealer providing clearing, securities liquidation, stock lending and margin services to small investors and introducing brokers.
segments.evidence: AtlasClearing is a correspondent securities broker-dealer registered with the SEC and a member in good standing of FINRA.

revenueModel.text: The company earns commissions and vetting fees on securities liquidations, stock locate fees from broker-dealers, service charges for clearing services, and interest spreads on stock lending and margin accounts.
revenueModel.evidence: It derives its revenue from the liquidation of restricted and control microcap securities; clearing transactions on behalf of an introducing broker-dealer on a fully disclosed basis; and trading in equity securities for its own account.

changes.text: In 2024 the company acquired Wilson-Davis, now known as AtlasClearing, a correspondent clearing company, and Quantum FinTech Acquisition Corporation.
changes.evidence: Through our 2024 acquisitions of Wilson-Davis (now known as AtlasClearing, Inc. "AtlasClearing"), a correspondent clearing company, and Quantum FinTech Acquisition Corporation ("Quantum")
